correctness.rationale: Full real n>=2 quadratic weighted isotonic projection: each differentiable chamber averages consecutive blocks; all line segments subdivide over finitely many chambers. The signed-step basis modulo constants gives exact fixed-partition variation norm; a crossing block [j+1,k] produces chord ratio ((s_k-s_e)w_j+(s_e-s_j)w_k)/((s_k-s_j)w_e). Explicit strict KKT multipliers make each chord ratio attainable by sufficiently near inputs. The upper convex-hull boundary of the mass-coordinate graph gives its least concave majorant and necessary/sufficient consecutive-slope concavity criterion; monotone hull algorithm O(n). Independently compared rational step norms against chord formula for four profiles. Endpoint weights zero are interpolating anchors, not edges. Only weighted quadratic finite chains, not posets or general losses.
